mapper.select: SELECT sem.emp_no, sem.emp_name, sem.emp_login as user_name, sem.phone_no, sem.email, sem.org_name_path org_name, sem.org_code, sem.position_name, (case when jrm.is_security>=1 then 1 else 0 end) as user_type FROM safety_employee_message sem left join (select job_code,count(1) is_security from ytsafety_sys_job_role_mapping where del_flag=0 group by job_code) jrm on jrm.job_code=sem.position_code where sem.status='NORMAL' and (sem.emp_no like CONCAT('%',#{userInfo},'%') or sem.emp_name like CONCAT('%',#{userInfo},'%')) limit 100

SELECT DISTINCT sr.emp_no, sr.emp_name, sr.user_name FROM safety_group_info gi LEFT JOIN ytsafety_sys_user_depart ud ON ud.depart_code = gi.code LEFT JOIN ytsafety_sys_responsible sr ON sr.user_id = ud.user_id LEFT JOIN safety_sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = sr.user_id AND ur.del_flag = 0 WHERE sr.status=0 and sr.del_flag=0 and gi.code = #{code} AND ur.role_code = #{safetyOfficer}

SELECT sem.emp_no, sem.emp_name, sem.emp_login as user_name, sem.phone_no, sem.email, sem.org_name_path org_name, sem.org_code, sem.position_name, (case when jrm.is_security>=1 then 1 else 0 end) as user_type FROM safety_employee_message sem left join (select job_code,count(1) is_security from ytsafety_sys_job_role_mapping where del_flag=0 group by job_code) jrm on jrm.job_code=sem.position_code where sem.status='NORMAL' and sem.org_code=#{orgCode}

select distinct sr.user_name AS userName, sr.emp_name AS empName, sr.emp_no AS empNo, em.phone_no AS phoneNo, em.email AS email, ud.depart_name AS departName from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr inner join safety_sys_user su on sr.user_id = su.id inner join ytsafety_sys_user_factory suf on suf.user_id = su.id and suf.factory_id = #{factoryId} inner join safety_sys_user_role surr on surr.user_id = su.id inner join safety_employee_message em on em.emp_no = sr.emp_no left join ytsafety_sys_user_depart ud on ud.user_id = su.id where sr.status=0 and sr.del_flag=0 and surr.role_code in
#{item}

select distinct sr.user_name AS userName, sr.emp_name AS empName, sr.emp_no AS empNo, em.phone_no AS phoneNo, em.email AS email, ud.depart_name AS departName from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr inner join safety_sys_user su on sr.user_id = su.id inner join ytsafety_sys_user_factory suf on suf.user_id = su.id and suf.factory_id = #{factoryId} inner join safety_sys_user_role surr on surr.user_id = su.id inner join safety_employee_message em on em.emp_no = sr.emp_no left join ytsafety_sys_user_depart ud on ud.user_id = su.id and ud.depart_code=#{departCode} where sr.status=0 and sr.del_flag=0 and surr.role_code in
#{item}

select fm.id, fm.field_code, fm.field_name, fmf.file_url from safety_field_manage fm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(file_url ORDER BY update_time DESC SEPARATOR '||'), '||', 1) AS file_url FROM ytsafety_field_manage_file GROUP BY id ) fmf ON fm.id = fmf.id where fm.field_type = 'risk_region' and fm.delete_falg = 0 and fm.parent_id IN
#{item}

select fm.id, fm.field_code, fm.field_name, fmf.file_url from safety_field_manage fm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(file_url ORDER BY update_time ASC SEPARATOR '||'), '||', 1) AS file_url FROM ytsafety_field_manage_file GROUP BY id ) fmf ON fm.id = fmf.id where fm.field_type = 'risk_region' and fm.delete_falg = 0
select * from ytsafety_sys_responsible where status=0 and user_type = 0 and del_flag = 0 and emp_no = #{empNo}

SELECT * FROM ytsafety_sys_responsible WHERE status=0 and user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM ytsafety_sys_user_depart WHERE depart_code = #{code}) and del_flag = 0 AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM safety_sys_user_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode})
